extraction_readiness.policy: READY requires every active dependency to resolve to the root Body or an explicitly permitted owner/object, with no unknown Sketcher references or external-file links.

limitations: FreeCAD 1.1.1 exposes ExternalGeometry (PropertyLinkSubList) and ExternalGeo (PropertyGeometryList), but the former can be empty while ExternalGeometryExtension Ref tokens are present in ExternalGeo serialization.
This manifest reports exact serialized subelement tokens. Human-readable Edge/Face names may not exist for persistent element-map references.
App::Link and ShapeBinder/XLink property payloads are preserved in link_properties_xml; resolve their targets in FreeCAD before treating external paths as portable.

method.constraints: External geometry order i maps to Sketcher geometry index -(i+3); constraint First/Second/Third fields are checked
method.note: This is a saved-document audit. Referenced helper Bodies are traversed through Tip, not their complete Group. Validate with target FreeCAD before geometry-changing repairs.
method.ordinary_edges: Saved Document.xml ObjectDeps plus serialized property-link and expression targets, excluding non-geometric Context links and PartDesign::Body/App::Part ownership containers; a referenced helper PartDesign::Body contributes its active Tip only. Root Body expressions are recorded as owner-level dependencies because they can control global placement. Cross-document spreadsheet expressions are recorded separately and must be explicitly allowed.
method.sketch_edges: Sketcher::ExternalGeometryExtension Ref values in each Sketcher ExternalGeo GeometryList, expanded recursively
